messages:
elaine-support: @sophie @miguel Heads up — Acme Health opened an escalation: after the rwd-model-2.3 rollout their assistant stopped reliably emitting the function/tool call \"get_patient_record\". Sometimes the tool_call is missing, sometimes present with wrong args. Seen across 3 customers so far.

kyle-acme: Hi team, reproduction steps below. This was on Dedicated-pool-ACME.

Request (curl):

```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME' \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-model-2.3","input":"Get patient\\'s latest lab results for patient_id=12345","conversation_id":"conv-987","tools":[{"name":"get_patient_record","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"patient_id":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'\n```

Observed (raw response):

```\n{"output":"I can look that up for you.","tool_call":null}\n```

Sometimes we see:

```\n{"output":"I'll fetch that.","tool_call":{"name":"get_patient_record","arguments":{"patient_id":null}}}\n```

Expected: tool_call present with patient_id = \"12345\".

elaine-support: Reported ~2026-11-03T15:20:00Z, affecting multiple accounts.

deploy-bot: rollout rwd-model-2.3 at 2026-11-03T15:00:12Z (deploy id: dpl-20261103-2)

miguel-eng: Can you paste the full request_id from Acme examples and the raw response body (not paraphrase)? Need to determine if the tool_call is being stripped at the API layer or never produced by the model.

kyle-acme: request_id: req_0a9f7c3b. Raw response attached to the ticket: \"{\\\"output\\\":\\\"...call get_patient_record...\\\",\\\"tool_call\\\":null}\" — reuploading to thread.

sophie-ml: Quick hypothesis: 2.3 changed our function-calling heuristic (\"tool_invoke_threshold\") to prefer free-text when model confidence is borderline. The model's tokenization/decoder changes can cause it to avoid emitting the structured tool_call token sequence. I ran a small internal reproducer and saw suppression of tool_call ~60% vs 2.2 on the same prompts.

miguel-eng: If it is model-behavior-only, immediate mitigation is rollback of hosted traffic and providing a rollback path for dedicated pools. Alternatives: post-processor heuristic to reconstruct tool_call (risky), or flipping the threshold at runtime for 2.3.

elaine-support: Customer asks for rollback ASAP. They have SLA commitments on the Dedicated pool.

deploy-bot: rollback dpl-20261103-2 initiated by miguel-eng at 2026-11-03T16:05:43Z

miguel-eng: Rolling back hosted routing to rwd-model-2.2 for affected regions. Beginning manual rollback for Dedicated pools now. Attaching canary logs as they stream.

sophie-ml: I pushed an emergency revert of the threshold change to the model infra as a temporary flag. PR submitted: https://git.redwood.internal/rwd/modelers/pull/482. Also adding an immediate eval run across our function-calling suite.

miguel-eng: Creating incident INC-2026-1103-1 to track this (severity P1 due to Dedicated SLA). Assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime. Elaine, please attach customer logs and CSM contact.

elaine-support: Done. Ticket updated and account team notified. Message to customer drafted: apology + rollback ETA + request to validate at 16:20 UTC. @kyle-acme can you confirm availability? :pray:

kyle-acme: Yes, I'll test at 16:20 UTC and report back. Thanks for the quick response. :thumbsup:

miguel-eng: Update: Hosted rollback completed in us-east-1 at 2026-11-03T16:12:03Z. Dedicated manual rollback in progress; will post status.

sophie-ml: After rerun with reverted flag on 2.3 we see invocation rates returned to baseline for the Acme prompt set. Long term: revert the heuristic in mainline, and add a regression test for \"invocation-presence\" and \"args-accuracy\" in CI. Also add nightly canary across top customer prompts.

deploy-bot: note: previous stable deploy dpl-20261015-4 (rwd-model-2.2) metrics archived.

kyle-acme: Confirmed after rollback the assistant resumed calling get_patient_record correctly. New raw response:

```\n{"output":"I'll fetch that.","tool_call":{"name":"get_patient_record","arguments":{"patient_id":"12345"}}}\n```

elaine-support: Closing loop with customer, offering post-mortem and SLA credit. Filing follow-up to add monitoring rule to Redwood Optimize to alert on tool_call drop >5% vs baseline.

miguel-eng: Postmortem items: collect model weight diffs, hyperparam changes, add integration test with customer repros, and ensure deploy gating includes function-calling eval.

sophie-ml: I'll add a canary prompt set for Acme samples and wire failure mode alerts into the alerting playbook.

elaine-support: Thanks all. Customer confirmed restored. Closing thread but keeping incident open for RCA. :white_check_mark:
